source_of_truth: Read by hand. There is no index.ts under app/components/ui, so per the contract every root component is public. StatusPill.vue has no leading comment and no @example, but app/components/ui/StatusPill.stories.ts sits next to it, and the contract defines documented as a leading doc comment, an @example, OR a sibling *.md / *.stories.* — so StatusPill is documented. Kbd.vue has no comment, no @example and no sibling Kbd.md or Kbd.stories.*: public and undocumented. Neither wraps a library component (both roots are plain <span>), so no wrapper finding is possible.

expected.rationale: public (no barrel) with no doc comment, no @example and no sibling .md or .stories.* file

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: documented by the sibling StatusPill.stories.ts, one of the three documentation forms the contract recognises
its root is a plain <span>, not a library component, and it declares props
